hypothesis: Correct simulation initialization consistently improves deployed emaV forecasts over seeded random initialization.
gate: Across both folds and both seeds: mean Rel-L2 gain >=0.15, no fold-average TKE drop >0.25, MVPE drop >0.10 or SPS drop >0.25. Otherwise retain random initialization. Timing is diagnostic only for identical architectures.
evaluation: E029 emaV and frozen bounds; whole-trajectory held-out real data. Existing folds are development evidence, not untouched tests.
